sources.title: Java Language Specification SE 21 §14.19 The synchronized Statement
Java Language Specification SE 21 Chapter 17 Threads and Locks

claims.text: JLS SE 21 specifies that synchronized acquires the monitor for the target object, executes the block, and unlocks the same monitor on both normal and abrupt completion; a single thread may acquire that lock more than once.

JLS SE 21 states that monitor unlock synchronizes-with subsequent lock on the same monitor, and the Java SE 21 Lock API requires successful lock/unlock operations to have the same memory synchronization effects as corresponding monitor lock/unlock actions.

The Java SE 21 Lock API documents nonblocking tryLock, timed tryLock, interruptible acquisition, flexible non-block-structured locking, and recommends lock/try/finally/unlock because explicit locks do not get synchronized's automatic lexical-scope release.

Java SE 21 documents ReentrantLock as a reentrant mutual exclusion Lock with the same basic behavior and semantics as the implicit monitor plus extended capabilities; it supports optional fairness, warns fair mode may reduce throughput and does not imply thread-scheduling fairness, and states that untimed tryLock may barge even for a fair lock.

The Java SE 21 Condition API defines Conditions as distinct objects that can provide multiple wait-sets per Lock, shows separate notFull/notEmpty Conditions, and specifies that await atomically releases the associated lock, waits, then reacquires it before return; spurious wakeups require waiting in a predicate loop.

The Lock API is an interface whose implementations may have differing properties and may allow concurrent access; the API does not require AQS or ReentrantLock as the implementation, so implementation-specific properties must not be generalized to all Lock implementations.

findings: 候选明确区分 synchronized、Lock 接口与常见 ReentrantLock 实现，按统一维度比较生命周期、获取方式、等待条件、选型与边界，并避免把 AQS、公平性或可重入性错误推广到所有 Lock。
JLS SE 21 与 Java SE 21 API 足以支撑 monitor 生命周期、happens-before、显式锁扩展 API、ReentrantLock 公平性边界及 Condition 多等待集；未使用版本敏感的 HotSpot 锁优化传闻。
